title: Crypto misuse: SHA sess_init leaks wc hash state on init failure
description: In wolfssl_sha.c sha_sess_init(), when wc_InitSha*() returns non-zero (line 164-168), the error path calls kfree(ctx) without calling the corresponding wc_Sha*Free() and without memzero_explicit(). wolfCrypt hash init may partially allocate internal state (e.g. SHA3 uses an inner struct that may have heap-allocated fields on some platforms). Trigger: wc_InitSha3_256/384/512 returns non-zero → wc_Sha3_*_Free never called → potential internal state leak, violates init/free pairing (check 2b) and FIPS 140-3 zeroization policy (check 2a).
